name: Aetherstride (Psychic)
summary: When this model Deep Strikes, it can arrive anywhere more than 6" from all enemy units; until end of turn its melee weapon gains Sustained Hits D3 but it cannot charge.

name: Ambushing Hunters
summary: At the end of the opponent's turn, if this unit is more than 6" from all enemy units, remove it from the battlefield and place it in Strategic Reserves.

name: Arcane Shield (Psychic)
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

name: Arch-Sorcerer of Tzeentch (Psychic)
summary: Each time this model attempts a Ritual, add 1 to the Psychic test result.

name: Bestial Prophet
summary: While this model leads a unit, add 1 to the Hit roll for attacks made by models in that unit.

name: Binding Tendrils (Psychic)
summary: After this model shoots, pick an enemy Infantry unit hit by its Arcane Fire attacks; until your next turn that unit's Move characteristic is reduced by 2" and its Charge rolls suffer -2.

name: Blazing Salvoes
summary: After this model shoots, pick an enemy unit it hit; until your next turn, attacks made by models in that unit suffer -1 to the Hit roll.

name: Brayhorn
summary: Re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

name: Destroyer of Futures
summary: When targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, this unit scores hits on unmodified rolls of 5+, or 4+ against an enemy unit within 9" of a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker unit.

name: Destroyer of Futures (Once per phase, per unit)
summary: You can target this unit with the Counter-offensive Stratagem for -1 CP, regardless of other uses of that stratagem this phase; it does not prevent other units from also using it.

name: Empyric Guidance (Psychic)
summary: While this model leads a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit gain the Lethal Hits ability.

name: Ensorcelled Annihilation
summary: Ranged attacks this model makes against a Monster or Vehicle already hit this phase by a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker's Psychic Attack can re-roll the Hit roll and the Damage roll.

name: Ensorcelled Destruction
summary: Ranged attacks this model makes against a non-Monster, non-Vehicle unit already hit this phase by a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker's Psychic Attack get +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Flame-wreathed
summary: After this model's Normal move, pick an enemy unit it moved over; until end of turn models in that unit cannot claim Benefit of Cover.

name: Glamour of Tzeentch (Aura, Psychic)
summary: While a friendly Thousand Sons Infantry unit is within 6" of this model, models in that unit gain the Stealth ability.

name: Glimpse of Eternity (Psychic)
summary: Once per turn, change the result of one Hit roll, Wound roll, or saving throw made for this model to an unmodified 6.

name: Herd Banner
summary: While the bearer's unit is within range of an objective marker you control, models in that unit gain +1 Leadership.

name: Hunter of Souls
summary: Attacks against Character units re-roll a Hit or Wound roll of 1 (or either roll entirely against Psyker Characters); destroying a Character heals this model D3 wounds, or 3 if it was a Psyker.

name: Illusions of Tzeentch (Psychic)
summary: While this model leads a unit, that unit can only be targeted by a ranged attack from within 18".

name: Immaterial Flare (Aura)
summary: While a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker is within 6" of this model, add 1 (non-cumulative) to that model's Psychic test result when it Channels the Warp.

name: Impossible Form (Psychic)
summary: Non-Psychic attacks against this model have their Damage characteristic reduced by 1.

name: Lord of the Planet of the Sorcerers (Psychic)
summary: This model can attempt two Rituals per turn instead of one, and adds 2 to the Psychic test result for each attempt.

name: Malefic Maelstrom (Psychic)
summary: While this model leads a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: Malign Trickery
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit and this unit is not within Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move of up to D6".

name: Marked by Fate (Psychic)
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, pick a visible enemy unit; until end of phase, attacks this unit's models make against it gain +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Mutating Vortex (Aura)
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, roll a D6 per enemy unit within 6", dealing 1, D3, or D6 mortal wounds on increasing results, then each affected unit must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Prophesied Doom
summary: After this unit ends a Charge move, roll a D6 for each of its models within Engagement Range of the charged unit; each 4+ deals 1 mortal wound to that enemy unit.

name: Prophetic Sentinels
summary: Once per turn, when this unit is targeted with Fire Overwatch or Heroic Intervention, that use of the stratagem costs -1 CP.

name: Rebind Rubricae (Psychic)
summary: In your Command phase, while leading a unit, roll a D6: on a 1 the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds, on 2-5 return one destroyed Bodyguard model, on a 6 return up to two.

name: Regenerating Monstrosities
summary: At the start of each Command phase, one model in this unit regains up to 3 lost wounds.

name: Rites of Coalescence
summary: While this unit contains a Psyker model, attacks that target it suffer -1 to the Wound roll.

name: Sacrificial Blessing
summary: When this model's unit is selected to shoot or fight, it may destroy a Bodyguard model in that unit to add D3 to the Attacks and Strength of its Psychic weapons until end of phase.

name: Scryer of Fates (Psychic)
summary: After deployment, you may redeploy up to three Thousand Sons units, optionally placing them in Strategic Reserves regardless of the normal Strategic Reserves limit.

name: Servile Pawns
summary: While within 3" of a friendly Thousand Sons Infantry unit, this model has the Lone Operative ability.

name: Snarling Protector
summary: You can target this unit with Heroic Intervention for -1 CP, without stopping other uses this phase. If it charges with a friendly engaged PSYKER within 12", it can re-roll the charge roll but must end engaged with an enemy of that Psyker.

name: Sorcerous Support
summary: After this model shoots, pick an enemy unit it hit; until end of phase, Psychic Attacks made against that unit by models that disembarked from this transport this turn get +1 to the Hit and Wound rolls.

name: Spirit Snare
summary: When a friendly Psyker with Cabal of Sorcerers is destroyed within 9" of a model with this ability, that model gets a permanent +1 (max +2) to its Ritual Psychic test results for the rest of the battle.

name: Time Flux (Aura, Psychic)
summary: While a friendly Thousand Sons unit is within 6" of this Psyker, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

name: Treason of Tzeentch (Psychic)
summary: At the start of the opponent's Shooting phase, pick an enemy unit within 24"; until end of phase, ranged weapons equipped by its models gain the Hazardous ability.

name: Twisted Sorceries (Psychic)
summary: Once per battle, in the Shooting or Fight phase, improve the Strength and Attacks characteristics of this model's Psychic weapons by 3 until end of phase.

name: Unearthly Power
summary: At the start of each battle round, select one ability from a fixed list of options; this model has that ability until the next battle round.

name: Cabal of Sorcerers
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, one eligible model can attempt a Ritual by rolling 2D6 (optionally Channelling the Warp, risking D3 mortal wounds for a higher result); meeting the Ritual's Warp Charge manifests its effect.

name: Cabal of Sorcerers
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, one eligible model can attempt a Ritual by rolling 2D6 (optionally Channelling the Warp, risking D3 mortal wounds for a higher result); meeting the Ritual's Warp Charge manifests its effect.

name: Cabal of Sorcerers (Scarab Occult Sorcerer only)
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase, one eligible model can attempt a Ritual by rolling 2D6 (optionally Channelling the Warp, risking D3 mortal wounds for a higher result); meeting the Ritual's Warp Charge manifests its effect.

name: Pact of Sorcery
summary: When building your army, your Army Faction cannot be Scintillating Legions.
